Definition: to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to flow, pour out, pour, gush forth, spring, bubble up, ferment; 1a) (Qal) to flow; 1b)(Hiphil) to pour out, emit, cause to bubble, belch forth; 1b1) to pour out; 1b2) to cause to bubble, ferment; 1b3) to pour forth, emit, belch forth
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
